emails_sent.subject: Weekly Project Status Update
emails_sent.body:
Dear Team,

This week we have made significant progress on the project. Here are some key updates:

- Task A has been completed.
- We started working on Feature B and have reached 50% completion.
- There were no major issues this week, but we encountered a minor bug in Component C which is now fixed.

Looking forward to another productive week ahead!

Best regards,
The Project Team
